replacement_claim: Acceptance uses only the pre-edge occupancy: in_ready is high exactly when occ is below 2. Therefore a full queue cannot accept input even when out_ready simultaneously removes the oldest element; that edge performs pop only and a replacement push must wait for a later cycle.
rationale: Inject a current-state-only full guard that omits the required full pop+push replacement case, and pair it with a calibrated RTL fault implementing the same decision.
